Three Straightforward Steps to Freedom from Sciatic Distress

No complicated protocols. Just morning and evening relief that fits seamlessly into your life whilst your nerve heals.

1

Apply Generously

Dispense three 10p-sized amounts and massage along the sciatic pathway – one for the lower back, one for the hip, and one for the back of the thigh. Use firm, circular pressure.

2

Allow Deep Penetration

Within 60 seconds you'll feel the luxurious absorption - no greasy residue. The cooling sensation signals menthol activating whilst deeper actives penetrate.

3

Repeat Twice Daily

Apply morning and evening for cumulative relief. Most users experience significant improvement by day 5-7, with optimal nerve calming achieved in 3-4 weeks.

FAQ

How is BioEdge different from the drugstore creams I've already tried?

    Most pain creams can't reach your sciatic nerve. They use water or cheap mineral oil bases that get blocked by your skin's stratum corneum barrier. BioEdge™ uses a dual-lipid carrier system (virgin coconut + jojoba oils) that mimics your skin's natural sebum, creating 40x greater absorption. Our pharmaceutical-grade curcumin actually penetrates to the nerve compression site - it's not just surface cooling.

How quickly will I feel relief from my sciatic pain?

    Within 20-30 minutes, menthol activates cooling receptors for immediate relief. But the real transformation happens over 2-4 weeks - curcumin reduces deep nerve inflammation while you live your life. Think: instant comfort while cellular repair happens beneath. By day 5-7, most notice they're sitting longer, sleeping better, moving freely.

Will this work if I have a herniated disc or nerve compression?

    BioEdge™ targets the inflammation and muscle spasms choking your nerve - where most pain originates. It can't "fix" a herniated disc, but it shrinks the swelling crushing your sciatic nerve. Many users with confirmed herniations report dramatic pain reduction that lets them function normally while avoiding surgery. It buys you time, relief, and options.

What if I have sensitive skin or allergies?

    BioEdge™ is formulated without synthetic fragrances, parabens, or harsh preservatives that trigger most sensitivities. However, it does contain coconut oil (tree nut derivative) and botanical extracts. If you have tree nut allergies, consult your doctor first. For general sensitive skin, test a small amount on your inner wrist before full application. The jojoba base is sebum-mimetic, making it highly compatible with most skin types, including elderly and diabetic skin.

Can I use this if I'm already scheduled for surgery?

    Absolutely. Many users apply BioEdge™ while waiting for surgical consultation or as a trial before committing to invasive procedures. It's non-invasive with zero drug interactions. Some discover they can postpone or avoid surgery entirely as the nerve inflammation reduces. Always inform your surgeon about any treatments you're using, but topical bioactives pose no surgical contraindications.
